verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an agent-skills toolkit: a triage or refactoring skill could plausibly process many items in one pass. But nothing in the evidence documents such a capability. The triage skill moves issues through a state machine one at a time. Asking the whole question frontier in one round, and installing the whole skill set as a bundle, are adjacent behaviours, not bulk operations across many items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
